apply_mask_to_kspace: apply a sampling mask to k-space data using a MaskFunc to subsample MRI k-space
convert_numpy_to_tensor: convert a numpy array to a PyTorch tensor with complex values stacked along the last dimension
normalize_instance_data: normalize a tensor using instance normalization by computing mean and stddev from the data itself
center_crop_complex_image: apply a center crop to a complex MRI image tensor along the last three spatial dimensions
transform_varnet_data: transform raw k-space data into a VarNetSample with masked k-space, mask, and target for VarNet training
